/*****************************************************************************
* McStas instrument definition
* Instrument: NEAT/TOF spectrometer simulation
*
* %D
* Simulation of the NEAT time-of-flight spectrometer.
*
* %P
* lambda: [Angs] Incident wavelength
* dlambda: [Angs] Wavelength band
* rpm: [rpm] Chopper rotation speed
* coh: [str] Coherent S(Q,w) file
* inc: [str] Incoherent S(Q,w) file
* tmin: [s] Minimum TOF for monitor
* tmax: [s] Maximum TOF for monitor
*
* %L
* %E
*****************************************************************************/
DEFINE INSTRUMENT NEAT_TOF(
    lambda = 6.0,
    dlambda = 0.05,
    rpm = 10000.0,
    string coh = "Rb_liq_coh.sqw",
    string inc = "Rb_liq_inc.sqw",
    tmin = 0.01806,
    tmax = 0.01826
)

DECLARE
%{
  double Chopper2Detector;
  double KI, Vi, EI;
  double Emin, Emax, Vmin, Vmax, Tmin, Tmax;
  double time_elastic;
  char detector_options[256];
  char lmon_options[128];
  char tmon_options[128];
  char tmon_spec_options[128];
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  Chopper2Detector = 11.97 + 2.143 + 0.165;
  KI = 2 * PI / lambda;
  Vi = K2V * fabs(KI);
  EI = VS2E * Vi * Vi;
  
  printf("%s: Detailed NEAT/TOF configuration\n", NAME_INSTRUMENT);
  printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\n",
    lambda, EI, KI, Vi);
  
  time_elastic = 252.78 * Chopper2Detector * lambda * 1e-6; /* time from Chopper1 to reach Detector */
  printf("  Sample: coh=%s inc=%s\n", coh, inc);
  printf("          Elastic line time: %g [us]\n", time_elastic * 1e6);
  
  Emin = EI - 20; 
  if (Emin < EI / 3) Emin = EI / 3;
  Emax = EI + 20;
  Vmin = sqrt(Emin / VS2E);
  Vmax = sqrt(Emax / VS2E);
  Tmin = 2.5 / Vmax;
  Tmax = 2.5 / Vmin;
  
  sprintf(detector_options,
    "banana, abs angle limits=[13 136] bins=300, time limits=[%g %g] bins=256",
    time_elastic + Tmin, time_elastic + Tmax);
  sprintf(lmon_options, "lambda limits=[%g %g] bins=100", lambda - dlambda / 2.0, lambda + dlambda / 2.0);
  sprintf(tmon_options, "tof limits=[%g %g] bins=100", tmin, tmax);
  sprintf(tmon_spec_options, "tof limits=[%g %g] bins=100", time_elastic + Tmin, time_elastic + Tmax);
%}

TRACE

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Progress bar and Source                                                     */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

COMPONENT PG = Progress_bar()
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
    radius = 0.155,
    focus_xw = 0.03,
    focus_yh = 0.055,
    lambda0 = lambda,
    dlambda = dlambda,
    I1 = 1.4e12,
    T1 = 43.7,
    T2 = 137.2,
    I2 = 2.08e12
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Primary Flight Path Guides                                                  */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

COMPONENT Guide0 = Guide_gravity(
    w1 = 0.03, h1 = 0.055, l = 2, m = 1.2
)
AT [0, 0, 2] RELATIVE Source
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide0_copy = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_0 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_1 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_0 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_0

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_2 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_1 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_1

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_3 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_2 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_2

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_4 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_3 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_3

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_5 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_4 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_4

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_6 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_5 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_5

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_7 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_6 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_6

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_8 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_7 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_7

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_9 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_8 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_8

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_10 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_9 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_9

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_11 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_10 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_10

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_12 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_11 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_11

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_13 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_12 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_12

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_14 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2+1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_13 ROTATED [0, 2.0/2500*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_13

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Intermediate Diagnostics & Chopper 1                                        */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

COMPONENT Guide_PSD = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = "y x", restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 2 + 1e-4] RELATIVE Guide0_copy_14
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = lmon_options, restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 1e-4] RELATIVE Guide_PSD
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Chopper1 = DiskChopper(
    radius = 0.24, yheight = 0.06, nu = rpm / 60.0, isfirst = 1, xwidth = 0.03
)
AT [0, 0, 1.2e-2 / 2.0] RELATIVE Guide_Lambda
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Secondary Guides & Chopper 6                                                */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

COMPONENT Guide_SGS1 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 1.2e-2] RELATIVE Guide_Lambda
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_SGS2 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2.41] RELATIVE Guide_SGS1
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_SGS3 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 5.065] RELATIVE Guide_SGS2
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_CGS = Guide_gravity(w1=0.03, h1=0.055, l=2, m=1.2)
AT [0, 0, 2.352] RELATIVE Guide_SGS3
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide2_PSD = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = "x y", restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 2.143 - 2 * 6e-3 + 1e-4] RELATIVE Guide_CGS
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide2_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = lmon_options, restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 1e-4] RELATIVE Guide2_PSD
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide2_dXY = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = "dx dy", restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 1e-4] RELATIVE Guide2_Lambda
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Chopper6 = DiskChopper(
    radius = 0.24, yheight = 0.06, nu = rpm / 60.0,
    delay = 252.78 * 11.97 * lambda * 1e-6, xwidth = 0.03
)
AT [0, 0, 1.2e-2 / 2.0] RELATIVE Guide2_dXY
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_time = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.03, yheight = 0.055, options = "y x", restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 1.2e-2 / 2.0] RELATIVE Chopper6
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_DGS = Guide_gravity(
    w1 = 0.03, h1 = 0.055, l = 2, m = 1.2
)
AT [0, 0, 2.143] RELATIVE Guide_CGS
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Sample and Detectors                                                        */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

COMPONENT Sample_pos = Arm()
AT [0, 0, 2.143 + 0.165] RELATIVE Guide_DGS
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Sample = Isotropic_Sqw(
    Sqw_coh = coh, Sqw_inc = inc,
    xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.06, zdepth = 0.002, p_interact = 0.99
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_pos
ROTATED [0, 45, 0] RELATIVE Sample_pos
SPLIT 10
EXTEND
%{
    if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT Ideal_Det = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = 2, restore_neutron = 1, radius = 2.5,
    options = detector_options
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_pos
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Detector = PSD_Detector(
    nx = 640, ny = 256, radius = 2.5, yheight = 2.0, zdepth = 0.01,
    threshold = 100, PressureConv = 8, PressureStop = 1,
    dc = 0, borderx = -1, bordery = -1,
    xChDivRelSigma = 0, yChDivRelSigma = 0.0037,
    angle = 136 - 13, filename = "NEAT.psd",
    FN_Conv = "Gas_tables/He3inHe.table",
    FN_Stop = "Gas_tables/He3inCF4.table"
)
AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_pos
ROTATED [0, (136 - 13) / 2.0 + 13, 0] RELATIVE Sample_pos

END
